title: Resize Video – Change to 1080p, 720p or Square, No Upload
description: Change a video's size in pixels: 1080p, 720p, 480p, an Instagram square, a 1080 × 1920 story, or your own width and height. Runs in your browser.
heading: Resize a Video
subtitle: Change a video's width and height to a common size or your own, keeping its shape; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Make a 4K clip 1080p for a website, shrink a recording to 720p for a slide deck, or fit a video into an Instagram square or a 1080 × 1920 story. The 1080p, 720p, 480p and 360p sizes keep the video's shape. When the new size has a different shape, the whole picture fits inside it with black bars, so nothing is cut off. The new size is shown before you start.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your video is resized by your own browser and never sent to a server.

features.title: Ready-made sizes
features.text: 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, Instagram square and story sizes in one list.

features.title: Nothing cut off
features.text: A new shape adds black bars instead of cutting the picture.

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Pick a video or drop it on the page.

steps.title: Pick a size
steps.text: Choose a size from the list, or Custom size and type the width and height.

steps.title: Resize and download
steps.text: Click Resize video and download the result.

handles: Sizes: 1080p, 720p, 480p and 360p by the shorter side, 1080 × 1080, 1080 × 1920, or any width and height from 16 to 7680 pixels.
Shape: kept for the p sizes and with Keep the shape; other shapes get black bars.
Formats: MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV keep their format; M4V, AVI, OGV and 3GP videos become MP4.
limits: Only the first chosen video is resized.
Making a small video bigger doesn't add detail; it only makes the pixels larger.
Widths and heights are rounded to even numbers, which every player needs.

faq.question: Is my video uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Resizing is done by your own browser, on your device, with the video encoders built into it. Nothing is sent to a server; open your browser's network panel while it runs and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Does resizing make the file smaller?
faq.answer: A smaller size in pixels usually gives a smaller file. To aim for a file size in MB, use Compress video.

faq.question: How do I fill a square without black bars?
faq.answer: Crop the video to a square first with Crop video, then resize it to 1080 × 1080 here.

faq.question: What does 720p mean for a vertical video?
faq.answer: The shorter side becomes 720 pixels, so a phone video becomes 720 × 1280 and keeps its shape.

faq.question: Which browsers does it work in?
faq.answer: Recent Chrome and Edge read and make the most formats; Safari and Firefox work with most videos. If your browser can't read or make a codec, the page names it and says what to try instead.

faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
